meta.title: Recipient typed with a spelling mistake is refused
gaps: Open Asha's mailbox and the Procol approval request email
Click Consult to create a reply with an Action:Consult subject
Enter a comment and send the misspelled recipient chetan@dlf-hospitality.con without changing the subject
Wait for and observe the mailbox bounce-back stating that chetan@dlf-hospitality.con is not part of the organisation on Procol
